subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should this issue be narrowed to local avatar failure diagnostics while preserving the current workspace-bound avatar route, and how should the open fork PR that still closes it be disposed?
rationale: The original valid-file path is fixed, but the remaining user-visible behavior involves avatar-route security policy and an open conflicting fork PR, so automation should not silently choose the product/security contract or PR disposition.

options.title: Narrow to local diagnostics
options.body: Treat the remaining work as a focused local-avatar diagnostics bug and close or supersede the stale fork PR after preserving any useful test idea.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer repair conflicts, require live Windows/browser proof, and perform a security review before considering the fork branch as the fix path.

options.title: Fold into broader avatar contract work
options.body: Move the remaining discussion under the broader Control UI avatar contract issue if maintainers want one policy decision for local and remote avatar failures.

recommendation.title: Narrow to local diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat the remaining work as a focused local-avatar diagnostics bug and close or supersede the stale fork PR after preserving any useful test idea.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main avatar route, UI diagnostics, and security-sensitive serving behavior point to this recent area contributor as the best routing candidate.
